subject.title: A stale candidate asks a fresher quorum to forget

capsule.title: A stale candidate asks a fresher quorum to forget
capsule.summary: A node isolated during replication later campaigns with an older log. Granting its vote could erase a committed suffix, so voters reject it on term and index freshness.
capsule.trigger: Keep node 3 isolated while nodes 1 and 2 replicate a new entry, then heal node 3 and let it campaign after isolating node 1.
capsule.observed: Node 3 has a strictly smaller last index and cannot transition to leader even after increasing the election term.
capsule.invariant: A voter grants leadership only when the candidate's last log term and index are at least as fresh as its own.
capsule.fix: Compare the candidate's last term first and last index second before persisting a vote.

timeline.title: Starve one follower
timeline.detail: Node 3 misses a replicated entry while the other two nodes preserve a majority.

timeline.title: Campaign with a short log
timeline.detail: The stale node increments term and requests votes from nodes holding a longer suffix.

timeline.title: Compare last indexes
timeline.detail: The fixture asserts node 3's index is lower before the campaign begins.

timeline.title: Deny leadership
timeline.detail: Fresh voters reject the request and committed history remains leader-complete.

limits: Membership is fixed; joint consensus and dynamic reconfiguration are outside this model.
